dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high median pixel intensity across the entire visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency of very faint, localized light-grey pixel clusters toward the posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope between faintly pigmented posterior regions and the mature white baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of a distinct longitudinal linear mark on the anterior-left dorsal plane and a cluster of fine, parallel high-contrast marks near the posterior tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint linear epidermal scratches or rake marks visible on the dorsal surface.
